span.p: 開始查詢 ListWithFees() 或 FindWithFee()

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
調用 NormalizeToMinute(entry, start)
與 NormalizeToMinute(reference, end)
(統一設 tm_sec = 0，對齊至本地整分鐘)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
返回 false / kInvalidTime
(保持調用方輸出不變)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 計算秒數差: seconds = difftime(end, start)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
計算總停留分鐘數:
total_minutes = seconds / 60

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
按 24 小時 (1440 分鐘) 週期拆分:
days = total_minutes / 1440
remainder = total_minutes % 1440

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
計算顯示用時長字段:
hours = remainder / 60
minutes = remainder % 60

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
計算剩餘部分向上取整計費小時數:
started_hours = (remainder + 59) / 60
partial = started_hours * 20

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
應用單個 24 小時週期 400 MOP 封頂:
capped_partial = min(400, partial)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
計算總費用 (整數澳門元):
mop = days * 400 + capped_partial

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 寫入 ParkingFee 結果並返回 true
